author: Erocawaii
quote:
Pros: the world and graphics are really beautiful.

Cons: Terrible story with equally terrible main characters. Lucia is quite possibly the worst and most annoying female protagonist in any game I have ever played. Jason could be redeemable if his personality existed. As he is now, he's like a boring NPC. Bland, forgettable, and a weak simpleton for a terrible mother who chose to leave her infant alone in a cafe with strangers while she impulsively, and poorly, tried to rob a store with zero forethought and planning.

Oh also no prostitutes and no garage to put in any cars you steal. You're stuck with a POS car with terrible handling. 

This isn't the GTA you remember. This is the GTA you will want to forget ever existed.

quote: Boring game that is constantly pandering to the current political climate. Stopped playing halfway through chapter 1 because the narrative felt so forced and repetitive. Glad it was accessed through PlayPass and didn't actually buy it.
